description: List machine-verified specification changes since a YYYY-MM-DD date or ISO-8601 timestamp (newest first, default 50, max 200). Returns { changes: [{ id, date, record_id, kind, field, from, to, claim, evidence_url, detector, commit }], total, since } filtered optionally by lifecycle step or record_id. Use changes for field-level spec diffs; use stale to audit unverified records or digest for daily ecosystem news.

limit.description: maximum number of change entries to return (default 50, max 200)

record_id.description: optional standard id or acronym to filter changes (e.g. mcp, a2a, x402)

step.description: optional lifecycle step filter (discover, identify, permit, read, act, coordinate, pay, present, account)

name: changes
